evidence.quote: Access tokens have a limited lifespan of 15 minutes (900 seconds)
If more than one page of results is available, the response includes an opaque `next_page_token`.
Retrieve a list of users in a 1Password account.

assumptions: The base URL is set to the US region (api.1password.com). Accounts in Canada (api.1password.ca), Europe (api.1password.eu) or ent.1password.com would need a different host, and the token URL would change too.
The account ID must be supplied by the customer; the docs do not describe a call that looks it up.
The scope users.view is assumed to be the one needed to list users; the docs show it in examples but do not state the scope for each endpoint.
Users who are pending confirmation or in account recovery are not returned by the API, so their licences will not be seen.
Accounts that use automated provisioning are documented as not supported by the Users API.
No last-active signal was found, so usage is marked unavailable. The Events API may offer sign-in data, but its endpoints were not in the provided source.
Role and user type are not in the user record; service accounts are not listed separately.
The plan requirement is 1Password Business or Enterprise Password Manager (not Teams).
The page size of 1000 is the documented maximum.
